ambient_events: "CUSTOMER SATISFACTION IS OUR PRIORITY" plays from overhead speakers. The voice sounds increasingly uncertain.
description: A vast warehouse complex that The Franchise faction uses as a distribution hub. Everything here has a SKU. Everything here is for sale.

flags.intro_lore: The Franchise moves everything worth moving through these bays, which makes it the basin's beating heart and just as easy to stab. Everything here belongs to somebody, and that somebody has people. Lift the wrong crate and you won't be robbed — you'll be made an example, and examples in Coldwater don't get sequels.

name: The Loading Bay West
